What does the 14-day free trial include?
Your free trial includes full access to all Joist Run features for 14 days, with no contracts, hidden fees, or credit card required.
Try everything—estimates, invoices, payments, and more—before you commit.
Is there a free version of Joist available?
Joist’s free plan is no longer available, but all users can try Joist with the 14-day free trial, risk free, at no cost. The free trial gives you access to all Joist Run features through our web and app platforms. At the end of the trial, you’ll be prompted to purchase a plan that fits your needs.
What is the difference between the Pro, Elite and Run plans?
Joist Pro is built for contractors who want to create unlimited estimates and invoices and stay on top of day-to-day work.
Joist Elite adds advanced tools like reporting, change orders, and deeper client organization features for growing businesses.
Joist Run adds even more organization to your toolkit with jobs and scheduling features.
Can I change or cancel my plan at any time?
Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your Joist plan whenever your business needs change. And if you choose a monthly plan, you aren’t locked into a long-term contract, so you can adjust your plan as your business grows.
Are there any hidden fees or setup costs?
No. There are no setup fees or surprise charges to start using Joist.
If you choose to accept online payments through Joist Payments, standard payment processing fees apply based on the payment method used.
What’s the difference between the Elite and Run plans?
Joist Elite is best for contractors who need advanced business tools, client management, and reporting.
Joist Run builds on the Elite plan with jobs and scheduling, giving contractors a more connected way to organize work as they take on more jobs and prepare for the next stage of their business.

Estimates FAQ
Can I create and send estimates from my phone at the jobsite?
Yes. Joist lets you create, customize, and send professional estimates directly from your phone or tablet. Build detailed, itemized estimates and send them before you leave the driveway, so customers can review the work and approve it quickly.
How do digital estimates help me win jobs against competitors with lower pricing?
Professional estimates help build trust with homeowners. Clean, itemized pricing, branded documents with your company logo, and jobsite photos make your estimates easier to understand and show customers you run a professional business. That confidence often helps contractors win jobs even when they aren’t the lowest bid.
Will the app help me price jobs accurately so I don’t underbid?
Yes. Joist is an estimating and job costing tool that includes line items, markups, taxes, and discounts so you can capture every cost involved in the job. This helps make sure your pricing covers materials, labor, and overhead so you know your profit before work begins.
Can customers review and sign estimates online?
Yes. Customers can view your estimate from their phone or computer and approve or sign it digitally. Once it’s signed, you have a clear record of approval so you can move forward with the job without paperwork or delays.
What happens if the project scope changes after the estimate is approved?
If the scope of work changes, you can create a change order to update the estimate with new work or pricing. This keeps everything documented and ensures both you and the customer agree on the updated cost before the work continues. Change orders help protect your profit and prevent misunderstandings during the project.

Does an invoicing app work for contractors?
Yes. Invoicing apps help contractors quote jobs, manage projects, process payments, and invoice like a pro. They cover labor, materials, project scope, and payment terms. When you’re ready to go fully digital, Joist lets you build and send professional estimates and invoices right from your phone, complete with your logo and brand colors.

Use a mobile invoicing app like Joist. You can manage your entire business from the jobsite or on the go—creating estimates, sending invoices, and collecting payments right from your phone or tablet. Joist is built for pros who spend more time on-site than in an office, so you can close out a job and get paid without ever stepping foot in a back office.
Are there free calculators or pricing tools for contracting jobs?
Yes. Joist offers free trade calculators for flooring, painting, and roofing to help you estimate material costs quickly and accurately. They help you factor in waste, labor, and dimensions so your quotes stay competitive and your margins stay protected. For more detailed pricing, Joist’s estimating app lets you add line items, markups, and taxes all in one place.
How do I look more professional to clients?
Looking professional comes down to being clear, organized, and consistent. Sending polished estimates, responding quickly, and outlining project details up front all help build trust. With Joist, you can create clean, branded estimates and invoices, collect digital signatures, take payments on-site, and manage every job from one app—so your business always puts its best foot forward.
How can contractors stay organized with estimates and invoices?
The key is keeping everything in one place. Joist helps you move a job from estimate to invoice to payment without switching apps or losing track of where things stand. You can see every job’s status at a glance, follow up on unpaid invoices automatically, and store client info so repeat work is even easier. Less admin, more time focused on the actual job.
